purpose: Ramp/ground pairings below the APCA body-text threshold that ALREADY ship. R1-P extended the ramp check to compiled mode blocks, which is what made them visible; an architecture wave may not repaint them silently, so they are recorded here instead. Decrease-only: a pairing not on this list fails the build, and an entry that stops failing may simply be deleted.
retire: sighted mode-palette work (R2/R3) gives each dark state a ramp derived against its own ground, at which point the -900 step stops being invisible and the entry is removed
provenance: 2026-09-15 (D6-2c-i): the artifacts compile from the neutral foundation + preset. rottay and evnto author no seeds, so no ramp ships in their base or mode blocks; bithire's dark block leaves its ground to the foundation and is checked against DARK_DEFAULT_GROUND. build:vertical-artifacts measured 0 pairings below the threshold, so the 16 entries (rottay base success/warning/error/info -900; bithire dark accent/success/warning/error/info -900; evnto dark primary/secondary/accent/success/warning/error/info -900) were deleted per the decrease-only rule. A ramp a preset authors later is measured against its own ground and re-adjudicated here.
